jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Multimedia Group
jobs.description: Join Canva's Multimedia Group as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer. You will design, build and deploy machine learning models that power Canva's multimedia editing features. You will work closely with product and engineering teams to understand requirements and translate them into scalable ML solutions. Responsibilities include developing and improving ML models for image, video and audio processing, conducting experiments to evaluate model performance, and collaborating with platform teams to deploy models at scale. Requirements include strong experience in deep learning, computer vision or audio ML, proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and experience with cloud-based ML infrastructure.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Specialist Platform and Experience
jobs.description: Canva is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join the Specialist Platform and Experience team. You will be responsible for building and scaling ML systems that power specialised design experiences for Canva's users. Your responsibilities include designing and implementing ML pipelines, developing recommendation and personalisation models, and working with cross-functional teams to ship features used by millions of users. Requirements include experience in large-scale ML systems, strong engineering fundamentals, and a track record of delivering ML features in production environments.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Fortescue is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data & AI team in Perth. You will be responsible for designing, building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that support our mining and green energy operations. Responsibilities include developing ETL processes, working with cloud data platforms, and ensuring data quality and reliability across our data ecosystem. You will collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand data requirements and deliver solutions that enable data-driven decision making. Requirements include strong experience in data engineering, proficiency in SQL and Python, and experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.

jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer – Data & AI
jobs.description: Fortescue is looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to join our Data & AI division. You will be responsible for transforming raw data into reliable, well-modelled datasets that power analytics and reporting across the organisation. Responsibilities include building and maintaining dbt models, working with stakeholders to understand analytical requirements, and improving data quality frameworks. You will partner with data engineers and business analysts to ensure data products are accurate and performant. Requirements include experience with analytics engineering tools such as dbt, strong SQL skills, and familiarity with modern data stack technologies.

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst
jobs.description: Bupa Australia is seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join our team. You will be responsible for analysing complex business processes and translating requirements into actionable solutions. Responsibilities include facilitating workshops with stakeholders, documenting business and functional requirements, performing gap analysis, and supporting system implementations. You will work closely with IT and business teams to ensure delivered solutions meet business needs. Requirements include strong experience in business analysis, excellent communication skills, experience with Agile methodologies, and the ability to work across multiple concurrent projects.

jobs.title: 2026 Data & Analytics Graduate Program
jobs.description: QBE Insurance's 2026 Data & Analytics Graduate Program offers an exciting opportunity to launch your career in insurance analytics. You will rotate across different teams within our data and analytics function, gaining exposure to actuarial analysis, data engineering and business intelligence. Responsibilities include working on real data problems that impact QBE's business decisions, developing analytical models, and contributing to reporting initiatives. Requirements include a degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science or a related field, strong analytical skills, and a passion for solving business problems with data.

jobs.title: 2026 Graduate Program – Digital, Data & Analytics
jobs.description: Sydney Water's 2026 Graduate Program in Digital, Data & Analytics is now open. You will join a team dedicated to using data to improve the delivery of water and wastewater services to Sydney. Responsibilities include supporting data analysis projects, contributing to digital transformation initiatives, and developing insights that help Sydney Water operate more efficiently. You will be mentored by experienced professionals and have the opportunity to rotate across different teams. Requirements include a relevant degree in data science, engineering, IT or a related discipline, and a genuine interest in using technology to solve real-world problems in the utilities sector.

jobs.title: 2026 Graduate Program – Data Analytics
jobs.description: Kmart Group's 2026 Graduate Program in Data Analytics gives you the chance to work with one of Australia's largest retailers. You will be part of a team that uses data to drive commercial decisions across merchandising, supply chain and customer experience. Responsibilities include building and maintaining dashboards, performing ad-hoc analysis, and working with large datasets to uncover actionable insights. Requirements include a degree in data science, statistics, commerce or a related field, strong skills in SQL or Python, and an interest in retail analytics.

jobs.title: Data Analytics Graduate – Digital Stream
jobs.description: The NSW Government Digital Graduate Program is looking for talented graduates to join its Data Analytics stream. You will work across NSW Government agencies to deliver data-driven insights that improve public services. Responsibilities include data wrangling, building analytical reports, and supporting data governance initiatives. You will rotate across different departments to broaden your exposure and develop your skills. Requirements include a degree in data science, statistics, computer science or a related field, and a commitment to public service. Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate findings clearly are essential.

jobs.title: Graduate Program 2026 – Enterprise Data & Analytics
jobs.description: NAB's 2026 Graduate Program in Enterprise Data & Analytics provides a structured pathway into data science and analytics within one of Australia's largest banks. You will work on projects that use data to improve customer outcomes and business performance. Responsibilities include developing analytical models, working with large-scale financial datasets, and contributing to the delivery of data products. Requirements include a degree in data science, mathematics, statistics or a related field, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and an interest in financial services.

jobs.title: Graduate Analyst Program 2026
jobs.description: Aurora Energy Research is seeking Graduate Analysts to join its Melbourne team. You will work on energy market analysis and modelling for clients across the energy transition. Responsibilities include building quantitative models of energy markets, analysing large datasets, and producing reports that inform investment decisions. You will be part of a small, high-impact team and have the opportunity to work on projects with real commercial significance. Requirements include a strong quantitative degree in economics, engineering, mathematics or a related field, excellent analytical skills, and an interest in the energy sector and climate change.

jobs.title: 2026 Graduate Program – AI Engineer
jobs.description: DXC Technology's 2026 Graduate Program is looking for AI Engineers who are passionate about building intelligent solutions for enterprise clients. You will join a global technology company and work on projects that use AI and machine learning to transform businesses across industries. Responsibilities include developing and deploying AI models, integrating AI solutions into enterprise systems, and working with clients to understand their requirements. Requirements include a degree in computer science, AI, data science or a related field, strong programming skills, and an enthusiasm for applying AI to solve real business challenges.

jobs.title: 算法工程师
jobs.description: 途虎养车招聘算法工程师，负责公司核心业务的算法研发与优化。岗位职责包括：负责推荐系统、搜索排序、用户画像等核心算法的研发；深入理解业务需求，将业务问题转化为算法问题并提出解决方案；跟踪业界最新算法进展，持续优化现有模型效果。任职要求：计算机、数学、统计等相关专业本科及以上学历；熟悉机器学习、深度学习基础理论；有推荐系统或搜索相关经验者优先；熟练掌握Python，有TensorFlow或PyTorch使用经验。

jobs.id: cn-中国移动研究院-ai算法实习生-2026-05-25
jobs.title: AI算法实习生
jobs.description: 中国移动研究院招聘AI算法实习生，参与人工智能技术研究与应用开发。岗位职责：协助开展自然语言处理、计算机视觉等方向的算法研究；参与AI模型的训练、优化与部署；整理技术资料，撰写研究报告。任职要求：在读硕士或博士研究生，计算机、人工智能、电子信息等相关专业；熟悉深度学习基础知识，掌握至少一种深度学习框架；具备良好的编程能力，熟悉Python；有相关科研经历或竞赛经验者优先。

jobs.id: cn-中国移动研究院-算法岗实习生数据科学-2026-05-25
jobs.title: 算法岗实习生（数据科学方向）
jobs.description: 中国移动研究院招聘数据科学方向算法实习生。岗位职责：参与电信大数据挖掘与分析项目；负责数据预处理、特征工程及建模工作；协助开展用户行为分析、网络质量预测等数据科学研究。任职要求：在读研究生，统计学、数据科学、计算机等相关专业；熟悉机器学习常用算法，具备扎实的数学统计基础；熟练使用Python进行数据分析，熟悉Pandas、Scikit-learn等工具；有实际数据分析项目经验者优先。

jobs.id: cn-中国移动研究院-大模型算法类实习生-2026-05-25
jobs.title: 大模型算法类实习生
jobs.description: 中国移动研究院招聘大模型算法实习生，参与大语言模型相关研究与应用开发。岗位职责：参与大模型预训练、微调（SFT、RLHF）等技术研究；协助开展大模型在电信场景下的应用探索；参与模型评估与效果优化。任职要求：在读硕士及以上，计算机、人工智能相关专业；了解Transformer架构及主流大语言模型技术；熟练使用PyTorch，有大模型训练或微调经验者优先；每周可实习不少于4天。

jobs.id: cn-广州日报传媒-ai应用岗技术方向-2026-05-25
jobs.title: AI应用岗（技术方向）
jobs.description: 广州日报传媒集团招聘AI应用岗（技术方向），致力于推动媒体智能化转型。岗位职责：负责AI技术在新闻内容生产、分发等场景的落地应用；参与智能写作、内容审核、个性化推荐等系统的研发；协助调研行业AI应用趋势，输出技术方案。任职要求：计算机、软件工程、人工智能等相关专业本科及以上；熟悉NLP或推荐系统相关技术；有大模型应用开发经验者优先；对媒体行业有兴趣，具备良好的沟通能力。

jobs.id: cn-泛微网络-大模型算法工程师-2026-05-25
jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师
jobs.description: 泛微网络招聘大模型算法工程师，负责企业OA及协同办公平台的AI能力建设。岗位职责：负责大语言模型在企业办公场景的应用研发，包括智能问答、文档理解、流程自动化等；进行模型微调、提示词工程及RAG架构设计；持续评估和优化模型性能。任职要求：计算机或相关专业本科及以上；熟悉主流大语言模型（如ChatGLM、Llama等）及其部署框架；有RAG或Agent开发经验者优先；具备良好的工程能力，熟悉Python。
